name: Diva's Door
disable: DC 38 Performance check (legendary) to cancel out the aria's soundwaves with another, DC 43 Thievery check (master) to pick apart the arcane energies, or Dispel Magic (9th rank, counteract DC 36) to counteract the trap

items.name: Resounding Aria
items.text:
Trigger A creature opens the warehouse's double door without uttering the password

---
Effect All creatures within area C2 take 6d12+37 sonic damage (DC 38 basic Fortitude save save); a creature that critically fails is permanently Deafened.

text: A loud aria in a soaring tenor issues from the door, sending soundwaves outward.
